The Launchpad · Step-by-Step

Get into the Launchpad

Welcome to the Launchpad, our community. This walks you in one step at a time. Ten minutes and you'll know where everything is.

Your progress saves, so you can stop and pick it back up anytime.

(1)
Step 1 of 12

Open the Launchpad on your computer

Your phone works too, but the first time is easier on a bigger screen.

🚀 launchpad.philstringer.com Open →
(2)
Step 2 of 12

No password yet? Set one

Open the page below, type the email you joined with, and click Reset my password.

🔑 Set my password Open →
Already have a password? Sign in and skip to step 4.
(3)
Step 3 of 12

Find the email and pick a password

Circle emails you a link within a minute. Click it, pick a password, and you're in.

Not in your inbox? Check spam and promotions. It's usually there.
(4)
Step 4 of 12

Add a photo and one line about you

Top-right corner, click your initials, then Edit profile. Add a photo and a one-line headline. That's what people see next to everything you post.

(5)
Step 5 of 12

Put yourself on the map

The member map shows where everyone lives. Client moving to Phoenix? Find a member there and send the referral to someone you already know. They can do the same for you.

1
Still in Edit profile, scroll to Location. Type your city, pick it from the list, then click Save changes:
Type your city, not just your state. A state alone won't put you on the map.
2
To see who's near you, click Members at the top, then Show map:
📍 Member map Open →
(6)
Step 6 of 12

Read Start Here

In the left menu, open Start Here. Read Welcome to the Launchpad and House rules. Two minutes.

1
The left menu. Start Here is the first room:
2
The two posts to read:
(7)
Step 7 of 12

Introduce yourself

Open Share Anything, click Start a post, and tell us three things: what you do, where you sell, and the one thing you want AI to fix first.

👋 Share Anything Open →
This is how the room learns your name.
(8)
Step 8 of 12

Office Hours with Phil

The first Monday of every month, 1:30 PM ET, on Zoom. Bring one real thing you're working on. Phil works through it live, so everybody learns from it.

📅 Office Hours Open →
That page shows the next date, with buttons to add it to your calendar. On the day, the Join button shows up there at 1:25 PM ET.
(9)
Step 9 of 12

Watch the training replays

Left menu, Live Training Replays. Every live training Phil has taught, start to finish. Watch any of them, any time.

▶️ Live Training Replays Open →
New live trainings show up in Live Trainings, right above it in the left menu.
(10)
Step 10 of 12

Pick a Stringer Step

Left menu, Stringer Steps. Click-by-click guides like this one, with real screenshots. Pick one and do it.

🧭 Stringer Steps Open →
The full library lives at stringersteps.com.
(11)
Step 11 of 12

Ask anything. Post a win

Ask the Room: stuck on anything, ask there. Members help members, and Phil answers the rest at Office Hours. Wins: post one by Friday, big or small. One becomes Win of the Week.

❓ Ask the Room Open →🏆 Wins Open →
(12)
Step 12 of 12

Get the app on your phone

The Launchpad runs on Circle. Get the Circle Communities app and sign in with the same email. The Launchpad shows up inside.

🍎 iPhone App StoreGet it →🤖 Android Google PlayGet it →
